observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 200.» (L12) and «p. 201.» (L34) in the right margin.
body L29: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «133,29, pro cognoscuntur. Idest l. cognoscuntur; idest.»; the printed «cognoscuntur. Idest» is kept.
body L31: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXII) read «133,31, pro deprehende; si l. deprehendes. Si.»; the printed «deprehende; si» is kept.
body L5: the last e of «nocturnae» is printed broken, like c.
body L18: a speck stands before «dicam» at the height of a hyphen; it is not a sign.
body L25, L26: specks stand under the t of «occidente» (L25) and under the s of «ascendentis» (L26), and a third between L26 and L27; they are not signs.
body L36: specks stand under the r of «quaere» and below it; they are not signs.
body L20: a speck stands between «inter» and «gradum» after «autem»; it is not a sign.
body L39, L41: the d of «ad» before «unam» (L39) is printed broken; the s of «utrosque» (L41) is printed broken, like <.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
